source_title: Policy interventions, disaster resilience featured at 21st science & tech conf - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Dehradun: Policy interventions, disaster resilience and technological innovation featured prominently at the 21st Uttarakhand State Science and Technology Conference, which concluded at Science City, Dehradun, on Monday.Organised by Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) on Oct 25 and 26, the two-day conference brought together researchers and stakeholders to discuss emerging technologies, sustainable development and ways to strengthen collaboration between scientific institutions and govt agencies.Eight brainstorming sessions were held on the second day, focusing on science, technology, innovation, policy, disaster resilience and regional development.
